hero.headline: ໂຊລູຊັນເຕັກໂນໂລຊີ, ປ້ອງກັນໄຟຟ້າ ແລະ ສຳຫຼວດດ້ວຍໂດຣນທີ່ໜ້າເຊື່ອຖືໃນ ສປປ ລາວ
hero.subheadline: ສະໜອງໂຄງສ້າງພື້ນຖານໄອທີ, ລະບົບປ້ອງກັນແຮງດັນສູງ, ລະບົບພະລັງແສງອາທິດ, ລະບົບໂດຣນກວດກາ, ຄວາມປອດໄພ ແລະ ບໍລິການດ້ານເຕັກນິກ.

intro.title: ຄູ່ຮ່ວມງານດ້ານເຕັກໂນໂລຊີທີ່ທ່ານໄວ້ວາງໃຈໄດ້
intro.body: Saypaseuth Advance Co., Ltd. ເປັນຜູ້ຈັດຈຳໜ່າຍຊັ້ນນຳດ້ານອຸປະກອນໄອທີ, ໂຄງສ້າງພື້ນຖານລະດັບອົງກອນ, ລະບົບປ້ອງກັນໄຟຟ້າແຮງດັນສູງ, ລະບົບພະລັງແສງອາທິດ, ລະບົບໂດຣນກວດກາ ແລະ ຄວາມປອດໄພໃນ ສປປ ລາວ. ພວກເຮົາໃຫ້ບໍລິການຈັດສະໜອງ, ຕິດຕັ້ງ, ບຳລຸງຮັກສາ ແລະ ສະໜັບສະໜູນດ້ານເຕັກນິກສຳລັບອົງກອນຕ່າງໆທົ່ວປະເທດ — ໂດຍວິສະວະກອນທີ່ໄດ້ຮັບໃບຢັ້ງຢືນ ແລະ ຄູ່ຮ່ວມງານເຕັກໂນໂລຊີທີ່ໜ້າເຊື່ອຖື.
intro.experience: ປະສົບການຫຼາຍປີໃນການບໍລິການລູກຄ້າລັດ, ພະລັງງານ, ທະນາຄານ, ອົງກອນ ແລະ SME.
intro.commitment: ພວກເຮົາມຸ່ງໝັ້ນໃນການໃຫ້ໂຊລູຊັນທີ່ໜ້າເຊື່ອຖື, ຄຳແນະນຳທີ່ຊື່ສັດ ແລະ ການສະໜັບສະໜູນຫຼັງການຂາຍທີ່ໄວ້ໃຈໄດ້.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our products, services, and quotation process.

items.q: How do I request a quotation?
items.a: Use the quotation form on our Contact page or the home page. Tell us what you need and our team will respond within 1–2 business days with a free, no-obligation quote.

items.q: Do you provide installation and maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We offer end-to-end service — supply, installation, commissioning, scheduled maintenance, and technical support for all product categories.
We serve clients throughout Lao PDR. For regional projects, we have experience working in China, Thailand, and Vietnam as well.

items.q: What brands and products do you supply?
items.a: We partner with leading brands including Dell, HPE, Cisco, Fortinet, Hikvision, APC, and many more — covering IT, security, UPS, solar, and electrical protection.

items.q: Do you supply solar power systems?
items.a: Yes. We supply solar PV panels, inverters, battery storage, and provide commercial, industrial, and residential installation with ongoing maintenance.

items.q: How can I get technical support?
items.a: Contact us by phone, email, WhatsApp, or the contact form. Our certified engineers provide responsive assistance for troubleshooting, maintenance, and warranty support.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you submit a contact or quotation form, we collect the information you provide — such as your name, company, phone number, email address, and message content. We may also collect basic usage data when you visit our website.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information solely to respond to inquiries, prepare quotations, deliver services, and communicate about your projects. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Data Storage & Security
sections.body: Form submissions are processed securely through our email service provider. We take reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at info@saypaseuth.com.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For privacy-related questions, contact Saypaseuth Advance Co., Ltd. at info@saypaseuth.com or 020 59916868.
